subject: stf
title: STF.------(R)DEF.
description: Chart on book p. 253 (PR.S(RD)II-7). STF (source transfer) is the subject; DEF (definition) is the partner, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From the subject: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications), COS-P (cosmic particulars) and C-CONT (composite continuance). From T-C-IMP: INFO-SOLD (information solidification). From COS-P: TRS (transition). From TRS: RT-ALGN (reality alignment) and PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). From C-CONT: MT-INFO (multi-information). From MT-INFO: CULT-AF-BS (culture affinity basis). From CULT-AF-BS: PER-DY (perception dynamics).
